notes.text: BLOCK WORKING: HEBBALU-ANAGODU: INTEGRATED EI BLOCK (ALT.1). (table)
COMMUNICATION: CIRCUIT-1: SM & EITHER SIDE OF TOP POINTS. (table)
CRANK HANDLES: (table)
UP SHUNT KEY FOR UP BLOCK SECTION IS PROVIDED IN ELECTRICAL KEY TRANSMITTER WHEN REMOVED PREVENTS THE CLEARING OF UP ADVANCED STARTER SIGNAL NO. 8.
FUNCTIONS: (table)
CALLING ON SIGNALS (TIME LAPSE FOR CLEARANCE:60SEC). (table)

CALLING ON SIGNALS 2C. 3C. 4C. CAN BE CLEARED ONLY AFTER TRAIN HAS OCCUPIED THE CONCERNED BERTHING TRACK AND STOPPED. THE SM SHALL ENSURE THAT THE TRAIN HAS STOPPED BEFORE CLEARING THE CALLING ON SIGNAL.
DUAL MSDAC INTERLOCKED WITH INTEGRATED EI BLOCK PANEL TO ENSURE COMPLETE ARRIVAL OF TRAIN IS PROVIDED FOR HEBBALU-ANAGODU SECTION. (ALT.1)
RESETTING OF BLOCK SECTION DUAL MSDAC INTERLOCKED WITH INTEGRATED EI BLOCK PANEL IN CASE OF FAILURE (ALT.1). (table)

EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE PROVIDED FOR ALL SIGNALS. UNDER FAILURE CONDITION BY CLICKING SIGNAL NORMAL AND BY INSERTING PHYSICAL EMERGENCY EM KEY 'IN' FOLLOWED BY ENTERING USER NAME AND PASSWORD. THEN CLICK ON CONCERNED SIGNAL, SELECT THE EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE FOLLOWED BY CONFIRMATION 'OK'. THE ROUTE GETS RELEASED AFTER 120 SEC. EACH SUCH CANCELLATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON A COUNTER.

EMERGENCY POINT OPERATION IS PROVIDED FOR ALL POINTS. UNDER TRACK CIRCUIT DOWN AND FAILURE CONDITION OF TRACK SECTION WHEN POINT IS NOT LOCKED BY SIGNAL ROUTE BY INSERTING PHYSICAL EMERGENCY EM KEY IN, THEN CLICK ON CONCERNED POINT BUTTON AND SELECT THE EMERGENCY POINT OPERATION (N/R) AS CASE MAY BE, FOLLOWED BY ENTERING USER ID AND PASSWORD WITH CONFIRMATION 'OK'. THE POINT CAN BE OPERATED IMMEDIATELY. EACH SUCH OPERATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON A COUNTER.

EXTREME EMERGENCY CH KEY IS PROVIDED. UNDER FAILURE OF EI, VDU COMMUNICATION OR VDU MONITOR FAILURE BY INSERTING PHYSICAL EXTREME EMERGENCY CH KEY IN AND PRESSING PUSH BUTTON, CH EXTRACTION TIMER WILL START AND CH CAN BE EXTRACTED AFTER LAPSE OF 120 SECONDS. EACH SUCH EXTRACTION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON A COUNTER.
MSDAC IS PROVIDED IN PARALLEL TO DC TRACK CIRCUIT IN ENTIRE YARD

RESETTING OF MSDAC IN CASE OF FAILURE OF TRACK SECTION: EACH TRACK SECTION CAN BE RESET INDEPENDENTLY FROM THE RESET BOX/ RESET MODULE OF RESET PANEL/VISUAL DISPLAY UNIT (VDU). NON RESETTABLE COUNTER SHALL BE PROVIDED FOR RECORDING EVERY OPERATION OF RESETTING.
RESET TYPE:
FOR TRACK SECTION ON A STRAIGHT LINE CONFINED BY TWO DETECTION POINTS, WHEN RESET IS APPLIED THE AXLE COUNTER SECTION SHALL GO TO "PREPARATORY RESET MODE".

FOR TRACK SECTION ON A TERMINATING LINE/SIDING LINE, POINT ZONE AND LADDER , THE RESET COMMAND FROM RESET BOX/RESET MODULE OF RESET PANEL/VISUAL DISPLAY UNIT (VDU) WILL BE TRANSMITTED ONLY AFTER VERIFYING THAT VERIFICATION SWITCH HAVE BEEN PRESSED AND TURNED IN THE LINE VERIFICATION BOX AT SITE AS A PROOF OF THE AXLE COUNTER SECTION BEING CLEAR PHYSICALLY.
CONDITIONAL HARD RESET IS PROVIDED FOR 9XT TRACK SECTION.
(a) 51BT/XT IS FOULING TRACK FOR MOVEMENTS WITH POINT 50 REVERSE. (b)64BT/XT IS FOULING TRACK FOR MOVEMENTS WITH POINT 65 REVERSE.
NEW FEATURES NOTE

EMERGENCY OVERLAP ROUTE RELEASE (OYN) PROVIDED UNDER ROUTE LOCKED CONDITION. AFTER COMPLETE ARRIVAL OF TRAIN ON BERTHING TRACK, BY CLICKING CONCERNED ROUTE BUTTON AND SELECT CONCERNED OVERLAP RELEASE F OLLOWED BY ENTERING USER NAME AND PASSWORD WITH CONFIRMATION 'OK'. THE OVERLAP GETS RELEASED AFTER 120 SECONDS. EACH SUCH CANCELLATION SHALL BE REGISTERED ON A COUNTER.
POINT CAN BE OPERATED MANUALLY EVEN IF CH KEY IS OUT TILL THE TIME KEY IS INSERTED INTO THE POINT MACHINE FLAP. ROUTE CAN BE INITIATED BUT SIGNAL CAN BE CLEARED WHEN CH KEY IS INSIDE THE KLCR RELAY.

AFTER ARRIVAL OF TRAIN, IF ROUTE IS LOCKED AND ALL TRACK ARE IN UP CONDITION, THEN EMERGENCY ROUTE RELEASE IS USED TO UNLOCK THE ROUTE. NORMAL CANCELLATION IS APPLICABLE ONLY WHEN TRAIN HAS NOT PASSED THE SIGNAL.
